grade.primary_choice: Keep .NET isolated worker on Flex Consumption with always-ready instances, scheduled pre-scaling and startup tuning
grade.notes: The answer rejects the rewrite, moves the fix to the hosting plan, and correctly picks out sale-day scale-out, downstream providers, the in-process and .NET 8 end of support, and the move away from Linux Consumption. Its one gap is cost: it says the always-ready baseline adds cost but never says the rest of the Functions estate can stay on pay-per-use.
